name: Varia VS3
details: Compact single-dose electric grinder with 38 mm conical burrs and a stepless dial (Gen 1 and Gen 2 share one chart).

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–0.7, espresso 0.2–3.3, moka pot 3.1–7.8, AeroPress 2.4–12.5, V60 3.7–8.4, filter coffee machine 2.1–11.6, French press 8.3–18, cold brew 10.1–19.6. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Same table on its Gen 1 page.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
